perks.name: Ensemble
perks.description: Improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.

perks.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
perks.description: Improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.

perks.name: Heating Up
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon increase accuracy and stability while improving vertical recoil.

perks.name: Encore
perks.description: Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.description: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.

perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.description: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Multikill Clip
perks.description: Reloading grants increased damage based on the number of rapid final blows made beforehand.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.description: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Thresh
perks.description: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.
